Position Description: Junior AI & Systems Developer
Reports to: Lead AI Engineer
Location: Takanini

Purpose of the Role
To support the Lead AI Engineer in building and maintaining Traffic Safe NZ’s
next-generation AI platforms while ensuring the team’s day-to-day technology
runs smoothly. You will be the "engine room" of the digital team—helping code
agentic workflows one hour and resolving a colleague's technical hardware or
software issue the next.

Key Responsibilities
AI Development Support: Assist in building and testing RAG (RetrievalAugmented Generation) pipelines and agentic workflows using Python and
TypeScript.
Systems Integration: Help connect our AI solutions with existing APIs,
databases, and workflow tools like n8n or Make.
Internal Tech Support: Act as the first point of contact for staff computer
issues, including hardware setup, software troubleshooting, and basic
network support.

JD example

3


Data & Evals: Assist in running "evals" to test the accuracy and safety of
our AI models.
Documentation: Maintain clear documentation for both our custom AI
systems and internal IT processes.

About You
The Tech Stack: You have a solid foundation in Python and/or JavaScript.
You’re excited about LLMs and automation.
Problem Solver: You enjoy the "detective work" of fixing a bug in code or a
glitch in a colleague's laptop.
Communication: You can explain technical fixes to non-technical staff with
patience and clarity.
Adaptable: You are comfortable switching gears quickly between highlevel dev work and immediate support tasks.
